verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing confirms it handles new-hire onboarding alongside employee self-service in one system. It also says new-hire data flows automatically into payroll. However, nothing in the evidence describes a self-serve flow that collects tax, work-eligibility, or banking information before the start date. Missing for 10: evidence of W-4 collection, I-9 verification, direct-deposit/bank detail capture, a pre-day-one self-serve onboarding link sent to the new hire, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
